summary: Phase 7C-1 frontend-only verification of the owner-facing 'Updates from your barn' read feed on /owner-portal. All 6 requested scenarios pass: feed renders for owner with correct positioning between OwnerDigestCard and Care Timeline, seeded Valentino published+owner_facing update displays with 'Care' chip and 'JUN 6, 2026' date header, feed is fully read-only (no buttons/forms/inputs/textareas inside the card), backend scoping confirmed via direct API check (only status=published & visibility=owner_facing returned), staff (admin) does not see the feed and the Owner Portal page still renders cleanly, and loading/empty state code paths are present with correct testids.

sample.body_start: Today's care routine was completed as scheduled

console_errors: One generic 'Failed to load resource: 401' observed during owner page load; not coming from /api/owner-updates (that call succeeded and returned the seeded item). Likely from an unrelated stale request on the page (e.g. service-requests / digest). Out of scope for 7C-1 — flagging only.

action_items: (Optional/non-blocking) Investigate origin of the lone 401 console message that appears on /owner-portal for the horse_owner session; not produced by OwnerUpdatesFeed and does not affect 7C-1 functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: OwnerUpdatesFeed.jsx: useEffect dependency [] is fine for one-shot load; if 7C-2/3 adds publish actions, switch to a re-fetch trigger or invalidation hook.
OwnerUpdatesFeed.jsx: horseName() falls back to 'Your horse' silently when horse_id is unknown; acceptable for read-only, but log a warning to surface stale linkages during dev.
Read-only contract is correctly enforced — no compose/edit/approve/publish/archive controls present inside owner-updates-feed card.
Page wiring in OwnerPortal.jsx correctly gates the feed behind user.role === 'horse_owner' and renders it between OwnerDigestCard and the Care Timeline card.
test_credentials: owner@equinesync.com / demo1234 (horse_owner), admin@equinesync.com / demo1234 (admin) — both from /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: None created during this run. Used the existing one-off reversible seed (Valentino linked to owner@equinesync.com with one published owner-facing routine update).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 7C-1 owner-facing read feed is verified. innerText test in Playwright will show 'CARE' instead of 'Care' because of CSS text-transform:uppercase on the chip; use textContent (or check for 'CARE' case-insensitively) when asserting the chip label. Date header is rendered visually as 'JUN 6, 2026' (uppercase) via the same CSS treatment; the underlying value comes from fmtDate('YYYY-MM-DD'). For staff role gating, the feed is conditionally rendered via `{isOwner && <OwnerUpdatesFeed/>}` in OwnerPortal.jsx, so it never mounts for admin/trainer/groom/vet. Next sub-phases 7C-2 (composer) and 7C-3 (review actions) are NOT built yet.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in 7C-1 scope; nothing to RCA.
